mostWorthwhile.text: Lighting the finished kaleidoscope was the best payoff: the described pattern made the earlier mirror and drum construction feel purposeful.

leastWorthwhile.text: Binding the mirrors and putting them in the tube were practical but predictable assembly steps.

surprise.text: The explanation that mirrors reflect one another as well as the objects showed how a small view becomes a much larger pattern.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the loose space in the colour drum had a clear mechanical purpose.

continue.text: Yes. The changing pattern and clear explanation of reflections make me curious about what another construction might do, although several assembly steps were routine.
